description: This file declares utility functions related to WebRTC peer connection setup, including creating and starting threads, creating the peer connection factory, and creating peer connections. It primarily contains function declarations within the 'cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming' namespace.

methods.name: CreateAndStartThread
methods.description: Creates and starts a new thread with a given name, returning a Result containing a scoped reference pointer to the rtc::Thread.

methods.name: CreatePeerConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates a WebRTC peer connection factory using provided network, worker, and signal threads along with an audio device module, returning a Result with a scoped reference pointer to the factory interface.

methods.name: CreatePeerConnection
methods.description: Creates a WebRTC PeerConnection instance with specified factory, dependencies, port range, and ICE servers, returning a Result with a scoped reference pointer to the PeerConnectionInterface.
